correctness.rationale: The source RESULT.md is a complete all-n reconstruction. For a partition of block sizes s_i, outgoing degree C(k,2) recovers k and incoming degree F=sum_i(2^(s_i-1)-1) recovers a first-round signature. A merge of sizes a,b yields 2(F(Q)-F(P))-1=(2^a-1)(2^b-1). The proof distinguishes off-diagonal pairs by v_2(M-1)=min(a,b), diagonal pairs by v_2(M-1)=a+1 and a size bound excludes diagonal/off-diagonal collisions. The second-round multiset of outgoing first-round colours thus recovers all unordered block-size pairs; counting appearances of each size r and dividing by k-1 recovers its multiplicity. The k=1 case is unique. Symmetric-group relabelling proves equality exactly on orbits. For sharpness the distinct 14-element types (1,1,3,3,3,3) and (2,2,2,2,2,4) both have six blocks and F=12; adding singleton blocks preserves collision. The finite n<=13 threshold is checked by exhaustive integer partitions, not extrapolated to all n. The theorem does not identify the lattice among other structures.
